description: Peer -> Master consented uplift: inventory, Qdrant snapshots, teacher traces and raw-KV manifests. Transport is 8091, signed by the peer node key, overlay-only, gated on the peer-held model-uplift capability.

transport.authentication: overlay source + Ed25519 request signature from a pinned peer node key + registry entry with model-uplift + freshness + nonce
transport.never: authority, a grant, a peer write path, an answer corpus

consent.scope: the node operator enables it; a user may opt out and their traces are excluded from datasets
consent.deletion: a user deletion request purges local and Master trace/inventory rows within 30 days; snapshots age out by retention
consent.raw_kv: captured only for opted-in training sessions or sampled prefixes; never every request by default

payload.usage: object with counts and token totals, never prompt text

snapshot.idempotency: upload_id + sha256; a duplicate returns 200 and writes nothing
snapshot.restore: only into a scratch collection; never overwrite a live collection

trace.content: full prompt/response in a compressed content-addressed blob, not in a Qdrant payload
trace.redaction: keys, secrets and excluded personal paths are removed before upload

kv_artifact.compatibility: usable for training only when the artifact's architecture matches the student, or through an explicit adapter experiment

implementation_state.kv_capture: peer-node/scripts/sparknet-vllm-kv-patch.sh installs sparknet-vllm-kv-dump.py into the live vLLM 0.2.7 model runner; a marker file triggers a prefill-only KV block dump. Verified live 2026-11-01 (299 blocks, 627 MB).
